intro: Roland's Doom is an abandoned, shadow-drenched mine tucked into the southeastern hills of Duskwood, just east of the Rotting Orchard. Once an ordinary delve, it has become infamous as a dangerous den overrun by savage worgen.

Cut into the ridges east of the Rotting Orchard, Roland's Doom long ago ceased to be a functioning mine. Instead, it serves as a violent staging ground for the Nightbane worgen pack, led by beasts such as Gutspill and Nefaru. The dark tunnels echo with guttural snarls and the reek of damp earth and blood, making it one of the most perilous corners in all of Duskwood for unwary travelers.
